question: Which among the following is Asia's largest freshwater oxbow lake?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kanwar lake** is the largest oxbow lake in **India and in Asia**.
 
• It is a **freshwater lake** located in the** Begusarai district** and is the **only Ramsar site in Bihar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wular Lake** is the **largest freshwater lake** in **India**, located in the state of **Jammu and Kashmir**.

 
 
• While it is a significant lake in terms of **size,** it is not classified as an **oxbow lake.**
 
• **Wular Lake** is a result of** tectonic activity** and is fed by the J**helum River.**
 
 
 
• **Bhojtal, **also known as **Upper Lake,** is a** large lake** located in **Bhopal**, the capital city of the state of** Madhya Pradesh** in **India**.
 
 
• It is an artificial lake created by Raja Bhoj during his reign. 
 
 
 
• **Nakki Lake **is a popular tourist attraction located in Mount Abu, a hill station in the state of **Rajasthan, India.**
 
• It is a small and **scenic lake surrounded by hills**. 

 [IMAGE: https://lotusarise.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Ramsar-Sites-1024x1024.jpeg]
